text:
lucy: Is this hail in Emeryville or did the sky drop a bag of popcorn? Tiny hard pellets on the sidewalk. :cold_face::ice_cube: anyone delayed?

omar: Yep — hail and slippery sidewalks. Just switched from scooter to walking. Scooter is currently a very dramatic penguin. :penguin:

devin: Caltrain says slow orders southbound due to ‘track weather events’. ETA +25 on the 8:12. Ugh. Link: https://transit.example/status/CT-209

rachel: Thanks @devin. Heads up: 2nd & Front bus replacement is packed. If you're near Jack London, consider the 6th St shuttle.

commute-bot: Advisory: Caltrain slow order between 3rd and Hayward until 09:00 due to hail accumulation on tracks. Expect 15–30min delays. https://alerts.example/ct-hail-2026

evan: If anyone needs a lift from Jack London to Soma I have room for one. Leaving in 10. Battery heated seats (jk). :car: Ping me.

lucy: @evan i will take you up on that if @rachel isn’t already carpooling — wet shoes are the emotional injury of the morning.

omar: Meme time: when your micromobility becomes micro-mess. *posts gif of scooter slipping on ice* :joy:

devin: Facilities actually salted the office steps — big shoutout to them. Saved my dignity. :clap:

rachel: I’ll meet @lucy at Jack London in 7. Also bringing extra socks (hotel sample size) and muffins. Really glad we have a slack for this nonsense.

evan: Confirmed: 1 seat open. Leaving now. See you at the valet of shivering commuters.

lucy: ETA 7. Also if anyone wants a muffin drop me a DM, i'm on a baked-goods mission today.

devin: Update: 8:12 delayed to 8:40. If you can remote in for the morning do it. Just ordered another coffee.

rachel: On the move 00. Stay safe y'all.

omar: Update: scooter intact, pride slightly injured but recovering. :sweat_smile:
